title: The Point of No Return
summary: The heroes travel the Xala-Cermau hyperlane into Wild Space to assault Inquisitor Draco's stronghold on Xala. Master Denia is held there — if she survived. The rescue attempt ends in sacrifice, and the heroes leave the edge of known space carrying the cost. This adventure is structurally optional — players who choose not to pursue Denia proceed directly to the finale, but without whatever advantage Xala would have provided.

marks.label: Beyond the Charts
marks.desc: Travel the Xala-Cermau hyperlane into Wild Space. Past here, the galaxy ends.

marks.label: The Stronghold
marks.desc: Locate and infiltrate Draco's fortress on Xala.

marks.label: The Rescue
marks.desc: Find Denia. If you saved her in Adv2, this is the second time you pull her out — from a fate even she had stopped naming. If she was abandoned in Adv2, this is the toll-path: you recover what you let happen.

paths.label: Pull her out of Draco's hand
paths.desc: You break her cell. You carry her out. The road that opened in Adv2 closes here, on her terms.

paths.label: Recover what you let happen
paths.desc: She is in Draco's keeping because Varth told you to leave her and you listened. Pulling her out now is not rescue — it is paying a debt you helped sign.

marks.label: The Inquisitor
marks.desc: End Draco on his own ground. The Inquisitorius loses a piece of its board.

marks.label: The Cost
marks.desc: Someone pays the price of the rescue. The Atonement track grows by the weight of who you spent.

marks.label: Carrying It Home
marks.desc: Leave the edge of known space. What you bring back changes the final fight — and what you saw of Draco's stronghold is its own kind of evidence.

marks.label: The Last Briefing
marks.desc: The Resistance staging dock. Sixteen ships. Twenty thousand crew. The Leviathan run is at first sun.

marks.label: The Crucible
marks.desc: The plan catastrophically fails. Improvise under fire to survive.

gearNotes.reason: Final preparations before the climax. Stock up — there is no resupply after this point.
Forging alliances requires secure channels. The Empire is actively hunting the heroes by this point.
Stock consumables before the finale. This is Varth's last shopping trip — buy everything.
Consumable. Stock multiples before the Leviathan assault. Once they are inside, every terminal bypass counts.
Stock ordnance for the final assault. This is the last resupply opportunity.
The Leviathan is an Imperial superweapon project — expect heavy droid and automated defenses. Stock up.
Tactical consumable for the finale. Buy in quantity.
Replace any used rope. The Leviathan's interior may require vertical movement or emergency escape routes.

encounters.name: Beat 1 — At the Resistance Forward Dock
encounters.trigger: Crew arrives at the Resistance staging area
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: The night before the Leviathan run. Resistance staging dock. The fleet the crew has assembled across adv8-9 is moored and prepping. Crews are loading torpedoes and doing pre-flight. The whole staging area smells like coolant and engine wash. Adv9 build-out should make this the calm-before-the-storm beat.

encounters.name: Beat 2 — Final Mission Briefing
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: The mission brief for the Leviathan boarding. Walk the crew through the boarding plan, the gravity well array objective, and the extraction window. Adv9 build-out should reference the varth-leviathan conversation by name — what the crew thinks they are doing here is NOT what Varth has been planning. The briefing is honest within the Resistance's knowledge but incomplete.

encounters.name: Beat 3 — The Last Quiet Night
encounters.trigger: Briefing ends, crew has the evening
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: The last private night before the run. Reserve overlay slots for any of: Maya (the cockpit conversation), Soren Vex if alive (a final dock-side beat — adv9 build-out may resolve his arc one scene earlier than adv10), Denia (post-rescue, if she was recovered), or any PC-PC quiet moment. This beat is the campaign's pre-finale exhale.
encounters.tactics: NO DICE — tonal closing scaffold. Multiple conversation slots reserved.

encounters.name: Beat 4 — Launch
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: The fleet launches. Adv10 begins on the deck of the Banshee at hyperspace transit. To be expanded in build-out.
